commit.message:
LU-20231 build: rename HAVE_GENL_DUMPIT_INFO

The macro name HAVE_GENL_DUMPIT_INFO is colliding with
the config check macros from OFED.

Rename it to HAVE_GENL_DUMPIT_INFO_FAMILY.
